name: Aleel
text: Aleel is a variant of the name used in the poetry of William Butler Yeats and other writers. MacKillop enters the form as a variant of the Irish name of the hero. The spelling points to the same figure as the main head.

attributes.attribute: variant in poetry of a larger form
